name: ThemeParticles - Default
description: The dust around a galaxy's hub, in the first theme's magenta. Deterministic by design — every position, size and orbit comes from a PRNG seeded off the hue — so the server and the client draw the same field and the page does not throw a hydration error. Sizes are skewed small so a few large particles give the band depth instead of it reading as one size drawn badly.
